description: This file is a shell script used for running tests related to optional configuration paths in a Git project. It includes test cases for validating the behavior of Git config commands when handling optional values.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets up or checks specific Git configuration values during tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts lines in the output to validate empty outputs.
